name: wan-2-2-i2v-a14b

wanVideo.architecture: Mixture-of-Experts (27B total, 14B active per step) — image-conditioned

resources.videoSecondsTypical: ~120-300s per 5s clip on RTX 4090 with offload; ~60-150s on A100

notes: Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B — image-to-video, MoE architecture. Takes a single still image plus optional text prompt and animates the image into a 5-second clip. Higher motion quality than the 5B variant; recommended when input photography matters (product shots, hero stills, brand imagery you want to bring to life). Apache 2.0. Requires inputImage in every request — text-only prompts are rejected with 400.
